questions.title: GMT to Uganda
questions.question: It is 3:00 PM at Greenwich (0°). What time will it be in Uganda which lies 45° East?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Diff = 45°.
Step 2: 45 ÷ 15 = 3 Hours.
Step 3: East is Ahead (Add).
Step 4: 3:00 PM + 3 Hours = 6:00 PM.

questions.title: Uganda to London
questions.question: If it is 2:00 PM in Uganda (45°E), what time is it in London (0°)?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Diff = 45°.
Step 2: 45 ÷ 15 = 3 Hours.
Step 3: London is West of Uganda (Behind). Subtract.
Step 4: 2:00 PM - 3 Hours = 11:00 AM.

questions.title: Uganda to Sydney (East-East)
questions.question: It is 2:00 PM in Uganda (45°E). What time is it in Sydney (150°E)?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Both are East. Subtract degrees: 150° - 45° = 105°.
Step 2: 105 ÷ 15 = 7 Hours.
Step 3: Sydney is ahead. Add.
Step 4: 2:00 PM + 7 Hours = 9:00 PM.

questions.title: Uganda to USA (Crossing GMT)
questions.question: It is 2:00 PM in Uganda (45°E). What time is it in New York (75°W)?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Cross GMT. Add degrees: 45° + 75° = 120°.
Step 2: 120 ÷ 15 = 8 Hours.
Step 3: West is Behind. Subtract.
Step 4: 2:00 PM - 8 Hours = 6:00 AM.

questions.title: Finding Longitude
questions.question: It is 12:00 Noon at GMT and 3:00 PM at City X. What is the longitude of City X?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Time diff = 3 hours.
Step 2: 3 × 15 = 45°.
Step 3: Time is Ahead (PM > Noon), so it must be East.
Answer: 45° East.
